interview.secured: A day is secured when every task in all of my challenges is done, and the screen shows a 1 day streak with Monday checked off.
interview.freeze: The app never explained a freeze in anything I saw, so I can't say what it is.
interview.selfReported: It means I marked the task done myself, like Read, and the app didn't verify it, though it never spelled this out beyond the label.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - The streak and the checked day feel satisfying, and posting proof to friends is appealing, but I'm not sure what happens if I miss a day.

goals.text: Create a new challenge for friends from the Create tab with one simple check-off task. On the success screen copy the invite link. Then finish today's task with Done and choose Post to friends.

errors: create: Typed text did not appear in the field.
device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.
